en.description:
Drivey Car is a bright little voxel driving game about momentum. The car handles the gas all by itself: no gas pedal, no reverse, just an endless open road it can't wait to eat. A perfect run never stops rolling. The world has other plans: crossing traffic, freight trains, roadworks. You get the wheel and the brake, and the art is using the brake as little as you can get away with.

Steer to pick your line. HOLD TO BRAKE at the edge of a crossing, let the traffic rush past, then release into the gap and the car leaps straight back up to speed. Watch the signals at the rail crossings and dash between the trains. Swerve around the cones, the stalled cars, and the cargo that truck up ahead definitely lost.

THE ROAD KEEPS CHANGING
- Cruise a dirt road through the countryside, past the fences and telephone poles.
- Hit the boulevard at dusk under the streetlights.
- Cross a quiet snowfield... and drive straight into a rusted-out dystopia.
- Then out into the dark, headlights lit.
- And it all comes back around. How far can you get?

FOUR WAYS TO DRIVE
- HIGHWAY: eight lanes of divided blacktop. Weave through slow traffic, or swing across the median to overtake. It fills in the longer you drive, and deep in a run the cars start changing lanes. They signal first.
- CROSSINGS: the gauntlet. Cross-streets, rail crossings, and roadworks. Time the gaps, run the reds.
- TWO-WAY: an undivided country road. Hug your side, or swerve across the line for the coins.
- DAILY RUN: one course, the whole world, one day. Same road for everyone, unlimited tries, its own leaderboard. New every day.

OUT ON THE ROAD
- Grab a shield to shrug off one hit, a magnet that pulls in nearby coins, a coin burst, or a spare life parked right in traffic. You start with three lives; the brave carry more.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drive: the car handles the gas all by itself. It always wants to go.
- Steer: drag left and right (or tilt) to choose your line.
- Brake: hold to stop on a dime when the road demands it. Let go and you surge right back to speed.
- Run it: the stoplights are for everyone else. You'll stop for a train, never for a red light.
- Collect: grab coins to unlock new cars in the garage.
- Survive: out of lives, and it's over. Retry is instant. Go again.

SCENIC ROUTE
- A gentler road for an easy evening: same worlds, calmer traffic, no leaderboards. Flip it off when you want the run to count.

PLAY ANYWHERE
- iPhone and iPad: touch-drag steering with a second finger to brake, or tilt steering where any touch brakes.
- Apple Watch: a full game on its own: steer with the Digital Crown (or tilt), press and hold to brake, no phone needed.

SEVEN ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACKS
- Pick your driving music in Settings, from an easy cruiser to a night-run pulse. Two tracks free, five more in the Supporter Pack.

WORLD LEADERBOARDS
- Every mode has its own optional Game Center board, plus the shared daily board, worldwide across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Or skip it entirely and the game plays exactly the same.

THE GARAGE
- Eight voxel cars: one free, three for coins, four in the Supporter Pack. Chase the next one.

SECRET AGENT PURSUER
- The Department is hiring. A pursuit mode for Supporter Pack owners: run four-lane pursuits, take rival agents off the road with oil slicks and spy gadgetry, mind the civilians, and climb the Department's ranks one dossier stamp at a time. Its own leaderboard, its own theme. iPhone and iPad.

SUPPORTER PACK
- One optional $2.99 unlock for anyone who wants to support the game: the Secret Agent Pursuer mode, 4 premium garage cars, a coin doubler, 5 bonus soundtracks, and a horn. Every core mode is free; this is just extra.

NO NONSENSE
No ads. No sign-ups. No tracking. No subscriptions: one optional Supporter Pack unlocks the extras, forever. Nothing about you ever leaves your device; the only thing you can send is a Game Center score, and only when you choose to compete.

Steer, brake, and see how far down the road you can get.
en.releaseNotes:
NIGHT IS FOR EVERYONE

Night Drive has left the Supporter Pack. Drive far enough now and the road goes dark for every player, in every mode, at no charge. Night was never going to be for sale.

The Supporter Pack keeps everything else: Secret Agent Pursuer, the four premium cars, the coin doubler, the five bonus soundtracks, and the horn.

ALSO IN THIS UPDATE
- The Night Drive switch moved into Settings for everyone, on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. It starts on. Turn it off to stay in daylight.
- The Daily Run drives the full rotation, night included, so the shared course looks the same for every player on it.
en.subtitle: Endless highway traffic dodger

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
THE ROAD KEEPS GOING

Highway and Secret Agent Pursuer used to stop getting harder about a minute in. Now they don't. Drive far enough and the traffic fills in, the pace lifts, and shields and spare lives get scarce. Long runs finally push back.

Deep in a run, cars change lanes. Watch for the amber blinker and give them room, or take the gap while you still can.

ALSO IN THIS UPDATE
- Quieter music and sound effects.
- Near miss scoring rebalanced, so one long chain no longer runs away with the board.
- Destroyed agents stay destroyed, and civilian cars keep their colors.
- Less shimmer on trucks and trains.
- Leaderboard scores post more reliably.
